name: 六分钟子弹冰台式制冰机款
description: 六分钟首批子弹冰，日产数十磅，整篮可取自清洁，夜低噪户外也能带

styleLock.direction: instant-ice countertop appliance suite: white studio product truth plus ice-blue infographic system plus warm outdoor scenes, pain-first and spec-locked
styleLock.temperature: icy neutral for studio and infographic frames, warm golden for outdoor scenes, muted cool for the night frame
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for hero and variant; vertical ice-blue gradient #E9F1FC to #AAC3E1 for mechanism and spec frames, spec cards may deepen to #91B5D6; real environments for scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: large top-front softbox with faint contact shadows for product; hard midday sun for outdoor; low ambient cool light with soft falloff for night; internal glow allowed only for water path and indicator LEDs
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white acrylic counter or light-gray #E7E7E7 photo table; scenes use white wood tables, stone counters, RV camp tables; body stays glossy black or teal lacquer
styleLock.typography: bold geometric uppercase benefit headlines, oversized numerals, dark charcoal on light grounds and white on gradient cards, one claim per frame
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons, clock-dial ring for duration, dashed dimension callouts, three-column spec rows, round LED status legend chips
styleLock.presentationRules: product occupies 45-60% in product frames and 15-25% in scene frames but always the anchor; ice visible in every frame; hands only in demonstration frames; graphics never covering the product; dark body needs rim separation on dark grounds
noDrift: no fourth primary color outside the palette
no cube or crescent ice shapes, bullet ice only
no fabricated ranking badges or sales figures
no other appliance models mixed in
no horizontal gradients, ice-blue vertical only
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: countertop bullet-ice maker e-commerce suite. Bright white studio hero with a filled ice basket and iced drinks; mechanism and spec frames sit on a vertical ice-blue gradient #E9F1FC to #AAC3E1 carrying bold uppercase headlines, oversized numerals, thin-line icons, clock-dial rings and dashed dimension callouts; the glossy black body #1E1E1E stays constant with a teal variant #7FB3B2 allowed and orange drink accents #F47004 for appetite appeal. Lighting is a large top-front softbox with faint contact shadows; outdoor scenes run hard golden-hour sun, the night scene runs muted blue-gray ambient for the low-noise story. One claim per frame, ice always visible, hands only in demos, no fabricated ranking badges or output figures - numbers come from the product facts only.
